opportunities.title: Fulbright All Disciplines Scholar Award to the USA
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens (or Irish citizens normally resident in Northern Ireland); hold a PhD or equivalent professional degree; cannot hold US citizenship/permanent residency.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university, as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme. Grant periods typically 3-6 months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Elon University Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing in The Isley International House at no cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens; PhD or equivalent professional degree.
opportunities.summary: Allows academics and professionals to teach and pursue independent research in any subject area offered by Elon University.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal College of Surgeons of England Award

amount.raw: £2,275 per month, converted to dollars; RCS England further grant covering basic NHS Salary costs up to resident doctor pay scale for up to 6 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK trainee Royal College of Surgeons of England members.
opportunities.summary: Allows UK trainee RCS England members to pursue research into a number of surgical areas at any accredited US higher education institution.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Rutgers University-Newark Scholar Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing provided; travel grant up to £1,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens; PhD or equivalent professional degree.
opportunities.summary: Allows academics and professionals to teach and pursue research on issues of the contemporary urban environment at Rutgers University-Newark for one semester (4 months).

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal Society of Edinburgh Scholar Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens; PhD or equivalent professional degree.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university.

opportunities.title: Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses, settling-in costs, professional development allowances; round-trip travel; dependent allowance

opportunities.summary: Allows researchers and professionals to conduct hands-on scientific research supporting the conservation and preservation of cultural and historic artifacts at the National Archives. Runs 5-12 months beginning September 2027.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Cardiff University Scholar Award

amount.raw: £3,000 per month; $1500 relocation allowance; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; postdoctoral, academic and professional applicants.
opportunities.summary: Enables scholars to undertake a four-to-six-month project of research, lectureship or teaching in any research-active department at Cardiff University.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Lancaster University Scholar Award

amount.raw: £3,000 per month; $1500 relocation allowance; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; postdoctoral, academic and professional applicants.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for a three-to-six month research project in any field of Science and Technology (STEM) at Lancaster University.

opportunities.title: Fulbright University of Exeter Scholar Award

amount.raw: £3,000 per month; $1500 relocation allowance; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; postdoctoral, academic and professional applicants.
opportunities.summary: Covers a three-to-nine month project for researching, lecturing or teaching in or across any research-active departments at the University of Exeter.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Edinburgh Napier University Scholar Award

amount.raw: £3,000 per month; $1500 relocation allowance; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: US citizens; postdoctoral, academic and professional applicants.
opportunities.summary: Covers a three-to-six month research project in nursing at Edinburgh Napier University.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Scotland Distinguished Scholar Award at University of Edinburgh

amount.raw: £27,500; accommodation stipend up to £1,250 per month; $1500 relocation; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eminent US scholars with significant publication and teaching record.
opportunities.summary: Contributes to the intellectual life of the university through seminars, public lectures and curriculum development in any discipline within the College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, based at IASH for six months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Glasgow School of Art Distinguished Scholar Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eminent US scholars with significant publication and teaching record.
opportunities.summary: Contributes to the intellectual life of the Glasgow School of Art through seminars, masterclasses, public research lectures and curriculum development in any discipline within the institution for six months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright University of Manchester Distinguished Chair

amount.raw: £27,500; up to £1,000 monthly housing allowance; $1500 relocation; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eminent US scholars with significant publication and teaching record.
opportunities.summary: Contributes to the intellectual life of the University through seminars, public lectures and curriculum development in any discipline within the Faculty of Humanities.

opportunities.title: Fulbright University of St Andrews Distinguished Scholar

amount.raw: £27,500; monthly housing allowance of £750; $1500 relocation; dependent allowance

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eminent US scholars with significant publication and teaching record.
opportunities.summary: Contributes to the intellectual life of the University through seminars, public lectures and research in any discipline.
